arxiv-1810-06699.description: Abstract In this paper we discuss the possibility of measuring the anomalous magnetic and electric dipole moments of the τ \tau lepton. The method consists in studying the spin precession induced by the strong effective magnetic field inside channels of a bent crystal with a dedicated setup at the CERN Large Hadron Collider. arxiv-2209-15597.description: Abstract Knowledge graph embedding aims to predict the missing relations between entities in knowledge graphs. arxiv-2405-03497.title: Long ranged stress correlations in the hard sphere liquid
arxiv-2405-03497.creator: Niklas Grimm, Martin von Bischopinck, Andreas Zumbusch, Matthias Fuchs
arxiv-2405-03497.description: Abstract The smooth emergence of shear elasticity is an hallmark of the liquid to glass transition. In a liquid, viscous stresses arise from local structural rearrangements. In the solid, Eshelby has shown that stresses around an inclusion decay as a power law r − D r^{-D} , where D D is the dimension of the system.

arxiv-2406-06633.title: PairCFR: Enhancing Model Training on Paired Counterfactually Augmented Data through Contrastive Learning
arxiv-2406-06633.creator: Xiaoqi Qiu, Yongjie Wang, Xu Guo, Zhiwei Zeng, Yue Yu, Yuhong Feng, Chunyan Miao
arxiv-2406-06633.description: Abstract Counterfactually Augmented Data (CAD) involves creating new data samples by applying minimal yet sufficient modifications to flip the label of existing data samples to other classes. Training with CAD enhances model robustness against spurious features that happen to correlate with labels by spreading the casual relationships across different classes.

arxiv-2410-21587.title: Supplementary Material
arxiv-2410-21587.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by . Hamiltonian Monte-Carlo (HMC) and its auto-tuned variant, the No U-Turn Sampler (NUTS) can struggle to accurately sample distributions with complex geometries, e.g., varying curvature, due to their constant step size for leapfrog integration and fixed mass matrix. In this work, we develop a strategy to locally adapt the step size parameter of HMC at every iteration by evaluating a low-rank approximation of the local Hessian and estimating its largest eigenvalue.

A fundamental problem is to construct weighted t t -designs with as few points as possible.

pmc-11443530.creator: Yusuf
pmc-11443530.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). In this study, we introduce a new separation of phases-based activity reporter of kinase (SPARK) for AMP-activated kinase (AMPK), named AMPK-SPARK, which reports the AMPK activation by forming bright fluorescent clusters. Furthermore, we introduce a dual reporter system, named GCaMP-AMPK-SPARK, by incorporating a single-fluorescent protein (FP)-based Ca2+ biosensor, GCaMP6f, into our initial design, enabling simultaneous monitoring of Ca2+ levels and AMPK activity.

pmc-12517719.title: Patient-reported outcomes as drivers of postoperative delirium in the postanaesthesia care unit
pmc-12517719.creator: Joana Berger-Estilita, Isabel Marcolino, Mia Gisselbaek, Christian Seidl, Thomas W. Buehrer, Ines Fortuna, Basak C. Meco, Finn M. Radtke, Sarah Saxena
pmc-12517719.description: BACKGROUNDValue-based healthcare emphasises patient-centred outcomes. However, Patient-Reported Outcomes Measures (PROMs) and Patient-Reported Experience Measures (PREMs) remain underused in peri-operative care. Postoperative delirium (POD) is a common and serious complication associated with increased morbidity and healthcare costs. Understanding the prognostic value of PROMs and PREMs may support identification and prevention of POD in the postoperative anaesthesia care unit (PACU).

pmc-13217852.title: Spontaneous pseudoaneurysm of a profunda femoris artery perforator in a pediatric patient
pmc-13217852.creator: Brian L Han, Osahon O Obanor, Auh Whan Park, Elliot S Rinzler, Alexandra Callan, Sheena Pimpalwar
pmc-13217852.description: Profunda femoris artery pseudoaneurysms are rare in pediatric patients, particularly in the absence of trauma or prior intervention. We report a spontaneous pseudoaneurysm arising from a perforating branch of the profunda femoris artery in a previously healthy 14-year-old boy who presented with acute thigh pain, swelling, and anemia. Initial ultrasound demonstrated a large intramuscular hematoma without internal Doppler flow.
